X.note: The 13% label is faded and sits on top of the 6% cube and the green cube behind it, so its description is low-contrast and hard to read. The 7% label covers the orange cube's top. The cubes are about the same height even though the values are 7, 6 and 13, so the visual misstates the quantities. 'ACTUAL' is repeated four times and adds noise. The dark empty grid fills the top half of the frame. The stage looks generic and the labels are crammed together.

Y.note: A real terrain map with a river and a location pin makes the place obvious. One coin means world price and four coins mean about 4×, so the quantity reads at a glance. The labels are crisp and high-contrast, and the white outlines on the coins help. Weaknesses: the 4× label hangs off only the last coin, the coins are small, and the 'world price' coin sits far from the other four. Nothing says why the Delaware River valley matters. The ESTIMATE badge is clear.

why: Y shows place and quantity at a glance with clean, legible labels, while X has overlapping, faded labels and cubes whose sizes don't match their numbers.
top_fix_for_weaker: Spread the three labels so none overlaps a cube or another label. Make the 13% label opaque with full-contrast text. Scale the cube heights to 7:6:13, or put them on a labelled baseline. Drop the repeated ACTUAL tags except the corner badge.
